theater: 法蘭西島、香檵與皮卡第

battle.name: 三亨利戰爭
battle.theater: 法蘭西島、香檵與皮卡第
battle.brief: 九七七年洛泰爾四世去世，幼子洛泰爾繼承西法蘭克王位，卡佩王朝乘勢爭王，雙方在法蘭西島、香檵與皮卡第拉鋸三年。休格·卡佩聯軍解了庫西之圍，卻未能攻破洛泰爾的城邑；九八○年洛泰爾在軍中病逝，帝國轉而承認卡佩派。卡面羅馬投石機正是攻城方世代承襲的拋石器。

kit.name: 投石機
kit.history: 把絞盤的勢能換成一塊石頭。攻城從此有了可以計算的破壞力。

countries: 三亨利戰爭在西法蘭克王國境內開打，交戰的兩邊並非國家對國家的正面對決，而是加洛林王位的主張對上卡佩系的公國聯盟。卡佩派以法蘭西島的休格·卡佩為核心，兵力來自王領地與一批敢於站出來的中樞封臣：比奧良的埃布勒一世、安茹的「灰披風」若弗瓦一世、兼任里昂主教的勃艮第伯爵奧托-威廉，以及佛蘭德伯爵阿努爾夫二世。休格沒有常備軍，戰時以王家軍令（ban）徵召直屬封臣的隨從，諸侯各自帶隊，集結與行軍全靠事前商議。洛泰爾派以洛林與凡爾登的貴族為骨幹：洛林的小查理是這一派的實際領袖，凡爾登的吉塞爾貝爾、凡爾曼杜瓦的赫伯特二世各據一方，北方還有諾曼底公爵亨利一世與其子理查，兩人先後站在不同陣營。帝國方面，奧托一世早於九七三年便承認休格為法蘭克人的王，後續的帝國使節也偏向卡佩派，但帝國自身裂痕更深：洛林親王與凡爾登伯爵都不願看見休格坐穩法蘭西島。兩邊的指揮系統同樣簡陋，沒有專職參謀，戰爭實際就是各支貴族私兵之間的角力。
countriesEn: The War of the Three Henries was fought inside the West Frankish kingdom, and it was not a plain confrontation between two states: it pitted the Carolingian claim to the kingship against a coalition of Capetian counties. The Capetian side was centred on Hugh Capet in the Île-de-France, and drew its troops from the royal domain together with a handful of mid-ranking vassals willing to take the risk: Ebles of Bourbon, Geoffrey Greymantle of Anjou, Otto-William of Burgundy (count of Burgundy and bishop of Lyon), and Arnulf II of Flanders. Hugh had no standing army; he mustered men through the royal ban, and each magnate led his own contingent, so gathering and marching depended on prior negotiation rather than on any permanent establishment. The Lotharingian party was built on the nobles of Lotharingia and the Ardennes: Charles of Metz was its real driving force, with Giselbert of Ardennes and Herbert II of Vermandois holding positions of their own, and in the north Duke Henry I of Normandy and his son Richard, who at different moments stood on opposite sides. On the imperial side, Otto I had already recognised Hugh as king of the Franks in 973, and the imperial envoys who followed leaned towards the Capetian claim; but the Empire itself was riven, since the Lotharingian princes and the counts of the Ardennes had no wish to see Hugh settle securely in the Île-de-France. Command structures were rudimentary on both sides, with no professional staffs: the war was, in effect, a clash between the private war bands of great lords.
people: 休格·卡佩是這場戰爭的當事人，也是它的受益者。他於九五六年以公爵身分承繼父親大休格留下的法蘭西島，一輩子只在諾曼底公爵與洛泰爾父子之間維持平衡。他手上沒有一支常備軍，能倚靠的只有自己的親信、幾位敢於反叛的公侯，以及九七三年皇帝奧托一世送來的正統性——奧托把加洛林王朝那套王權象徵交到休格手上，等於宣告法蘭克王冠不必再經過加洛林血脈。他的長子羅貝爾此時二十歲上下，隨父出席教宗使節主持的聖日耳曼大會，日後更在一連串繼承會議中被推舉，最後於九八七年加冕；這場戰爭的勝負說到底是一名少年的王位問題。洛泰爾是洛泰爾四世與洛林公主傑爾貝爾加所生的幼子，母親替他守住了洛林與凡爾登的關係，宮廷裡卻另有更強硬的人替他作主。洛林的小查理是洛泰爾派真正的主心骨，他迎娶皇帝姊妹阿德萊德、插手教會人事買賣，也因此被教宗使節當眾指責。諾曼底那條線最耐人尋味：父親亨利一世支持洛泰爾，兒子理查一世卻倒向休格，父子間的分裂直接改變北線的兵力分布。阿努爾夫二世與赫伯特二世先後在陣營之間轉換，每一次轉換都把成隊的武裝隨從帶去另一邊。
peopleEn: Hugh Capet was both a party to this war and its beneficiary. In 956 he had inherited the Île-de-France as a duke from his father Hugh the Great, and his whole life he had held his balance between the Norman dukes and the family of Lothair. He had no standing army; all he could rely on were his own close followers, the few great lords willing to rebel, and the legitimacy Otto I had handed him in 973, when the emperor passed the Carolingian regalia to Hugh and announced that the Frankish crown no longer had to pass through Carolingian blood. His eldest son Robert, around twenty years old, attended the assembly of Saint-Germain presided over by a papal legate alongside his father, was acclaimed at a series of succession meetings afterwards, and was finally crowned in 987; in the end the outcome of this war was the question of a boy's kingship. Lothair was the young son of Lothair IV and Gerberga of Lorraine; his mother held the connections with Lotharingia and the Ardennes for him, but harder men at court made the decisions for him. Charles of Metz was the real driving force of the Lotharingian party: he had married Adelaide, the emperor's sister, meddled in the buying and selling of church offices, and was accordingly denounced before the assembly by the papal legate. The Norman thread is the most instructive: the father, Henry I, backed Lothair, while the son, Richard I, came over to Hugh, and that split inside one family directly reshaped the balance of force on the northern front. Arnulf II and Herbert II each switched camps in turn, and every switch carried whole bodies of armed retainers across to the other side.
kits: 卡面這件投石機（onager）出自公元前三世紀前後的羅馬工匠：它不用配重，而是靠一束扭緊的筋腱或繩索儲能，操作手用絞盤把投臂拉回，一放手便把石彈甩出。羅馬作家維特魯威在《建築十書》裡描述過這類器械，晚期帝國的圍城紀錄（從耶路撒冷到尼西亞一役）也留下它們的身影；依據描述所作的重建模型可以擲出數十公斤的石頭，射程約在一百五十米上下，每發都要重新上弦，操作一次便耗掉一整班人馬的體力。放到九七七年，這台機器早已不是前線裝備：西法蘭克在十世紀末面對的城防多是木柵、土牆加木製角樓，圍城靠的是壕溝、坑道、衝撞槌與可移動的木製攻城塔，拉伸式拋石器在同一譜系中早已換了設計。因此在這場戰爭裡，投石機更像是「攻城方世代沿用的拋石器」這一概念的代表，而不是可以指名點名的制式裝備。實際上陣的兵器以長矛、斧、劍為主，重裝騎兵用矛與劍，步兵配長矛、雙刃斧與投石索；弓仍是主要投射武器，弩在當時的西歐尚無可靠記載。攻城方另有包覆羊頭的撞槌、覆以生皮或濕氈的移動木塔，以及在牆根挖掘的坑道。馬匹方面，每名重裝騎士自備數匹戰馬、一套鎧甲和長矛；後勤靠莊園交出的穀物、鹹肉、葡萄酒與飼料，軍隊還常就地徵收，沿途劫掠，靠冬季宿營解決糧食。
kitsEn: The onager on this card comes from Roman workshops of roughly the third century BC: it works without a counterweight, storing energy in a bundle of twisted sinew or rope, and a winch hauls the arm back until the crew lets go and the stone is flung. The Roman author Vitruvius described such machines in the De architectura, and the siege records of the late Empire, from Jerusalem to the siege of Nicaea, leave traces of them as well; reconstructions built from those descriptions throw stones of several tens of kilogrammes to a range of around a hundred and fifty metres, and each shot has to be re-cocked, which costs a full crew the effort of a whole load of work. By 977 the machine was long out of front-line service: the fortifications that West Francia faced in the late tenth century were mostly wooden palisades, earthen walls and timber towers, and sieges rested on ditches, sapping, rams and movable wooden siege towers, while the traction stone-thrower had long been superseded within its own family. So in this war the onager is better understood as the embodiment of the idea of the stone-thrower handed down by successive generations of besiegers, rather than as an identifiable piece of standard equipment. The weapons actually carried on campaign were spears, axes and swords; heavy cavalry fought with lance and sword, and foot soldiers with spear, double-headed axe and sling. The bow remained the main missile, while the crossbow has no secure attestation in the West of this period. Besiegers also had the ram with its sheep's-head fitting, movable timber towers covered in rawhide or soaked felt, and the sap dug at the foot of the wall. On the horse side, every heavy knight brought several warhorses, a suit of armour and a lance; logistics came from the manors in the form of grain, salt meat, wine and fodder, and armies regularly requisitioned on the spot, lived off the country, and solved the food problem by wintering in camp.
tactics: 十世紀的西歐沒有常備軍，戰術的骨架是「諸侯自帶隨從，王家軍令統一時間」。軍隊按封臣階級集結：重裝騎兵與其馬夫居中或置於兩翼，弓手與輕裝步卒散在前列與側翼，攻城時再把步卒拆成填壕、搬石、覆土、築障四類勞役隊。野戰裡，卡佩派依靠數量與多路同時壓迫：休格在九七九年曾打算率龐大聯軍直趨諾曼底，把亨利一世拉到自己一方，卻在出發前就因聯盟瓦解而退回；洛泰爾派則靠地理縱深與城邑屏障拖住對手，避免在法蘭西島的平原上打一場會決定一切的戰鬥。包圍與反包圍是這場戰爭的主要動作：九七八年洛泰爾一度圍困屬於卡佩派的庫西，休格率援軍逼近，對方遂解圍而去。城邑攻防中，守方占據高牆與投射武器射程之內的制高點，進攻方只能靠散兵與掘壕工兵慢慢消磨守軍的士氣與存糧。到九八○年，洛泰爾率大軍深入，途中病倒身亡——指揮官的隕落，加上疫病與冬季宿營的補給壓力，使聯軍不是被打散，而是自行散去。
tacticsEn: The tenth-century West had no standing armies, and the skeleton of its tactics was that each lord brought his own retainers while the royal ban fixed the timing. Levies were assembled according to the rank of the vassal: heavy cavalry and their grooms in the centre or on the wings, archers and light infantry spread along the front and flanks, and in a siege the foot were broken into working parties for filling ditches, carrying stone, piling earth and raising protective screens. In the field the Capetians relied on numbers and simultaneous pressure from several columns: in 979 Hugh planned to lead a large coalition straight into Normandy to pull Henry I over to his side, but the alliance fell apart before he moved and he withdrew; the Lotharingian side preferred to stall the enemy with depth of country and fortified towns, avoiding a single decisive battle on the plains of the Île-de-France. Besieging and relieving were the war's main actions: in 978 Lothair besieged Coucy, a castle held for the Capetians, and broke off the siege as Hugh's relieving force closed in. In the defence of towns the garrison held the high wall and the commanding ground inside missile range, while the attackers could only grind away at the defenders' morale and stored food with skirmishers and sappers. By 980 Lothair had driven deep into the royal domain and fell ill on the march; the loss of the commander, together with sickness and the pressure of provisioning a winter camp, dissolved the coalition without any battle breaking it.
data: 關於這場戰爭的數字，史料給得並不多，站得住的只有框架：戰爭自九七七年洛泰爾四世去世起算，到九八○年洛泰爾去世為止，前後約三年，密集的軍事行動集中在九七八至九八○年。捲入的領地超過西法蘭克王國的一半：法蘭西島、比奧良、勃艮第、安茹、諾曼底、佛蘭德、凡爾曼杜瓦、洛林、凡爾登，另加皮卡第的若干城邑。戰役層面可確認的點只有數個：庫西的圍城、教宗使節主持的聖日耳曼大會、洛泰爾在軍中病逝，以及九八七年羅貝爾於蘇瓦松被貴族推舉、同年在奧爾良加冕。傷亡數字在編年史裡幾乎全部缺席——雷米耶與普呂姆的記錄只寫「被擄」「被俘」與「村莊被焚」，不給人數，因此任何精確的死亡數字都屬臆測。裝備面的數字同樣要打折扣：羅馬投石機的拋石重量、射程與所需人馬，現代依據維特魯威描述所作的重建模型測得約為三十至五十公斤的石彈、一百至一百五十米射程、每發需十人上下重新上弦；這是重建值，不是九七七年戰場上的實測值。
dataEn: The sources are not generous with figures for this war, and only the framework can be relied upon: the conflict ran from the death of Lothair IV in 977 to the death of Lothair in 980, some three years, with the dense military activity concentrated between 978 and 980. More than half of the West Frankish kingdom was drawn in: the Île-de-France, Bourbon, Burgundy, Anjou, Normandy, Flanders, Vermandois, Lotharingia and the Ardennes, plus a number of towns in Picardy. Only a few episodes can be confirmed at the level of campaign: the siege of Coucy, the assembly of Saint-Germain presided over by a papal legate, Lothair's death in camp, and Robert's acclamation by the nobles at Soissons in 987 and his coronation at Orléans later that same year. Casualty figures are almost entirely absent from the chronicles: the accounts of Richer of Reims and Regino of Prüm note men taken captive, nobles seized and villages burned, but give no numbers, so any precise death toll is invention. The equipment figures need the same discount: for the Roman onager, the weight of the stone, the range and the crew required come from modern reconstructions built on Vitruvius's description, and measure at roughly thirty to fifty kilogrammes of stone, a range of a hundred to a hundred and fifty metres, and about ten men to re-cock the machine for every shot. Those are reconstruction values, not measurements taken on a battlefield in 977.
cause: 起因有兩層，近的一層是王位繼承，遠的一層是加洛林與卡佩兩系對「法蘭克王冠歸誰」的分歧。洛泰爾四世在九七六年末至九七七年之間去世，幼子洛泰爾繼承西法蘭克王位；按照加洛林家的老例，王位由父傳子、由加洛林血脈主持加冕，但卡佩家在休格手上已經經營了二十多年，中央王權的實樞——巴黎、聖日耳曼一帶的莊園、教會任命與軍令——全在他們手中。教宗一方自十世紀中葉起便拒絕為加洛林人加冕，等於在法理上卡死了洛泰爾的合法性；帝國皇帝奧托一世更在九七三年直接承認休格為法蘭克人的王，並把加洛林王朝的王權象徵交給他。於是對洛泰爾派而言，這場戰爭不是一次日常承繼，而是「正統」的保衛戰；對卡佩派而言，每一次加洛林君主登基都是對休格及其子孫的致命威脅。此外，雙方貴族各有各的理由：洛林與凡爾登的權力來自帝國的委任，卡佩派的中樞封臣則害怕休格把王權收得太緊；婚姻與聯姻更把這場王位爭議變成整個西北歐貴族網絡的重新排列。
causeEn: There are two layers of cause: the near one is a succession, the remote one is the disagreement between the Carolingians and the Capetians over who the Frankish crown belongs to. Lothair IV died between late 976 and 977, and his young son Lothair inherited the West Frankish throne. By the old Carolingian custom the kingship passed from father to son and was crowned by Carolingian blood; but the Capetians had now run the central business of the kingdom under Hugh for more than twenty years, and the real pivots of royal power — the manors around Paris and Saint-Germain, the appointment of bishops, the issuing of the ban — were all in their hands. From the middle of the tenth century the papacy had refused to crown a Carolingian, which legally closed the door on Lothair's legitimacy, and in 973 the emperor Otto I went further, recognising Hugh as king of the Franks and handing him the regalia of the Carolingians. For the Lotharingian party, therefore, this was not an ordinary succession but a defence of orthodoxy; for the Capetians, every crowning of a Carolingian was a mortal threat to Hugh and his sons. The great lords had their own reasons besides: the power of Lotharingia and the Ardennes rested on imperial delegation, while the mid-ranking Capetian vassals feared that Hugh would tighten his grip on the crown. Marriages and dynastic alliances turned the dispute over the crown into a reshuffling of the whole aristocratic network of north-western Europe.
impact: 短期看，這是一場沒有決定性會戰的戰爭，卻改變了西北歐權力的重心。直接後果是洛泰爾在軍中病逝後，洛林的小查理扶植洛泰爾的弟弟居伊（蘇瓦松主教）加冕；佛蘭德與諾曼底立刻翻臉，帝國使節也轉而承認卡佩派的羅貝爾，兩套王位主張在九八○至九八七年之間又僵持了七年，最終以羅貝爾於奧爾良加冕、居伊與奧多相繼失勢被囚告終。長期後果更為結構性：卡佩王朝由「巴黎地區的一個公爵家族」變成教會與帝國都承認的正統王權，貴族對王位的服從從此以受膏與選舉的形式重新確認；與此同時，戰時的聯盟還留下幾道未癒的裂痕——諾曼底公爵家族自此把法蘭西王位視為可以爭奪的目標，日後英格蘭的諾曼底諸王會循同一條路走到海峽另一邊；而凡爾登、洛林、凡爾曼杜瓦等中間王國也明白，只要法蘭西島的國王站得穩，帝國的邊界就會向自己這邊推進。
impactEn: In the short term this was a war without a decisive battle, yet it shifted the centre of gravity of power in north-western Europe. The immediate consequence was that after Lothair's death in camp, Charles of Metz had Lothair's brother Guy, bishop of Soissons, crowned; Flanders and Normandy immediately changed sides, and the imperial envoys in turn recognised Robert of the Capetian line, so that the two rival claims remained locked in stalemate for another seven years, from 980 to 987. The end came with Robert's coronation at Orléans and with Guy and Odo losing ground and being imprisoned. The longer-term consequences are more structural: the Capetians were transformed from one ducal family of the Paris region into a legitimate kingship acknowledged by both church and empire, and the aristocracy's submission to the crown was reconfirmed in the forms of anointing and acclamation. At the same time the alliances of the war left wounds that never healed: the ducal house of Normandy henceforth regarded the French crown as something worth contending for, and the Norman kings of England would later follow the same road to the far side of the Channel; and the intermediate realms of the Ardennes, Lotharingia and Vermandois understood that as long as the king of the Île-de-France stood firm, the imperial frontier would advance towards them.
result: 打完了：洛泰爾派輸了這場王位戰爭。決定性的因素不是某一次會戰，而是三件事疊加——洛泰爾本人在九八○年軍中病逝，使北方聯盟失去唯一能把諸侯綁在一起的君主；卡佩派從教宗與帝國那邊取得正當性，可以在缺少會戰勝利的情況下繼續存在；而佛蘭德與諾曼底拒絕承認蘇瓦松主教居伊的加冕，使加洛林的最後一線失去北方的武裝支持。戰後的格局是：休格·卡佩仍只是法蘭西島的公爵，實權握在各地封臣與王領地官吏手中，但「法蘭克人的王」這頂名號連同教會的膏油祝福已經落在他的家族；九八七年其子羅貝爾在蘇瓦松被眾貴族推舉，同年在奧爾良加冕，開啟了延續至十四世紀初的卡佩王朝。洛泰爾的份封隨即轉到別人手上，凡爾登的吉塞爾貝爾在九八○年代中期被刺身亡，洛林的小查理在九八○年代末退隱修院，加洛林家族在西部留下的王位主張至此正式收場。
resultEn: It was over: the Lotharingian party lost the war for the crown. What decided it was not any single battle but three things together. First, the death of Lothair himself in camp in 980 removed the only monarch capable of holding the northern coalition together. Second, the Capetians had secured recognition from the papacy and the empire, so they could continue to exist even without winning a field engagement. Third, Flanders and Normandy refused to accept the coronation of Guy of Soissons, which stripped the last Carolingian line of its armed support in the north. The settlement after the war was this: Hugh Capet remained only a duke of the Île-de-France, with real power in the hands of the territorial vassals and the officials of the royal domain, but the name of king of the Franks, together with the church's anointing, had already descended to his family. In 987 his son Robert was acclaimed by the assembled nobles at Soissons and crowned at Orléans later that same year, opening the Capetian dynasty that was to rule until the early fourteenth century. Lothair's share of the royal inheritance passed to other hands, Giselbert of the Ardennes was assassinated in the middle of the 980s, Charles of Metz withdrew to a monastery in the late 980s, and the Carolingian claim to rule the west was finally closed.
